fields.body: Completed 200 square feet of roof membrane to original W-06. Same material and detailing as tender; no extra work, owner direction or obstruction. Elevator vendor booked the planned annual inspection separately.
Tender roof membrane area is 200 square feet at the upper landing. Product and lap details unchanged.

fields.clauses.0.title: Elevator inspection appointment
fields.clauses.0.text: The Contractor shall give the building manager 48 hours written notice before a scheduled elevator inspection. This appointment requirement concerns access only and does not concern changes to scope, cost, or time.
fields.clauses.1.title: Document copies
fields.clauses.1.text: Provide two electronic copies of operation manuals at closeout.
